His

Biography

His is the governor’s court magician on Ingos. A knife associated with him becomes a misleading clue in Brissen’s murder. He admits that a staged caravan was intended to expose raiders and that the nugget had already been stolen. His planned meeting with an informant ends with his own murder; Crooked’s confession identifies the attempt to silence him. [1, 2, 3, 4]
